title: Length of a Retail Transition Supply (Formulary Benefit)
content:
A retail transition supply under the Formulary Benefit runs for the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill. It is never less than zero and never more than that maximum, and it is taken as a whole number of days.

| Member's Northbridge formulary | Retail transition supply |
|---|---|
| any of the six formularies | the formulary's maximum days supply for one transition fill, in whole days |

*Worked figure (hypothetical maximum).* On a formulary whose maximum for one transition fill is 30 days, the retail transition supply is 30 days. If a formulary's maximum were 34 days, the supply would be 34 days.

*Boundary of the figure.* The supply never exceeds the formulary's maximum for one transition fill and is never below zero. It is a whole number of days.
